posts.zh:
dsh-turn-marks 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-29b3a3eb30a760d7477b.html
posts.en:
dsh-turn-marks is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-29b3a3eb30a760d7477b.html
